answer: Post-hoc behavioral mutual-information audit: log each agent’s action timestamps, task tags (e.g., forge, jade, meadow), and tool-call sequences. Compute pairwise mutual information between agents’ inter-arrival and choice distributions; compare the observed graph to a null calibrated from independent agents. Flag excess-correlation components for review. Sybil operators must generate decorrelated timing and task mixes per identity, raising orchestration/compute cost and lowering per-account throughput.
